mapper.select: SELECT * FROM mall_game_server WHERE server_id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT s.*,c.name category_name FROM mall_game_server s JOIN mall_game_category c ON c.category_id=s.category_id WHERE s.server_id=#{id} AND s.del_flag='0'
SELECT * FROM mall_game_server WHERE category_id=#{categoryId} AND name=#{name} AND del_flag='0' FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM mall_game_server WHERE category_id=#{categoryId} AND del_flag='0' AND status='1' ORDER BY sort,server_id
SELECT s.*,c.name category_name FROM mall_game_server s JOIN mall_game_category c ON c.category_id=s.category_id ORDER BY c.sort,c.category_id,s.sort,s.server_id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mall_game_server s JOIN mall_game_category c ON c.category_id=s.category_id
mapper.update: UPDATE mall_game_server SET name=#{name},sort=#{sort},status=#{status},remark=#{remark},version=version+1,update_by=#{updateBy} WHERE server_id=#{serverId} AND version=#{version} AND del_flag='0'
UPDATE mall_game_server SET del_flag='2',status='0',version=version+1,update_by=#{actor} WHERE server_id=#{id} AND del_flag='0'
